<module id="barrel_shifter">
    <description>A barrel shifter for rotating bits efficiently. This 8-bit barrel shifter takes an 8-bit input and shifts or rotates the bits based on a 3-bit control signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input to be shifted.</input>
        <input id="ctrl" width_description="[2:0]">3-bit control signal that determines how many positions to shift. The control signal specifies the amount of shift, where each bit indicates a shift by 1, 2, or 4 positions.</input>
        <output id="out" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit shifted output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Define the mux2X1 submodule here
        module mux2X1(
            input sel,
            input [7:0] in1,
            input [7:0] in2,
            output [7:0] out
        );
            assign out = sel ? in1 : in2;
        endmodule
        
        // Declare variables for storing intermediate results
        reg [7:0] interm_result_1, interm_result_2, interm_result_3;
        
        // Instantiate the mux2X1 submodule for stage 1
        mux2X1 stage1_mux1(ctrl[2], in, {in[3:0], in[7:4]}, interm_result_1);
        mux2X1 stage1_mux2(ctrl[2], {in[3:0], in[7:4]}, {in[5:0], in[7:6]}, interm_result_2);
        mux2X1 stage1_mux3(ctrl[2], {in[5:0], in[7:6]}, {in[7], in[7:1]}, interm_result_3);
        
        // Instantiate the mux2X1 submodule for stage 2
        mux2X1 stage2_mux1(ctrl[1], interm_result_1, {interm_result_1[5:0], interm_result_1[7:6]}, interm_result_1);
        mux2X1 stage2_mux2(ctrl[1], {interm_result_1[5:0], interm_result_1[7:6]}, {interm_result_1[7], interm_result_1[7:1]}, interm_result_2);
        mux2X1 stage2_mux3(ctrl[1], {interm_result_1[7], interm_result_1[7:1]}, {interm_result_1[7:3], interm_result_1[7:6]}, interm_result_3);
        
        // Instantiate the mux2X1 submodule for stage 3
        mux2X1 stage3_mux1(ctrl[0], interm_result_1, {interm_result_1[6:0], interm_result_1[7]}, interm_result_1);
        mux2X1 stage3_mux2(ctrl[0], {interm_result_1[6:0], interm_result_1[7]}, {interm_result_1[7:2], interm_result_1[7]}, interm_result_2);
        mux2X1 stage3_mux3(ctrl[0], {interm_result_1[7:2], interm_result_1[7]}, interm_result_1, interm_result_3);
        
        // Assign the final output
        assign out = interm_result_3;
    </implementation>
</module>
